description: Read the text/Markdown content of a file attached to a Workroom thread or sent by a customer (PDF, image, or document). Extracts on first read and caches the result. Returns status "ready" with markdown, or "skipped"/"failed"/"not_found" with a reason. Use when a message references an attachment you need to read.

attachmentId.description: The attachment ID from the message attachments list

name: get_attachment_text

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
